'''Nunn''': {{legend0|#0d0596ff|100%}} | title = [[List of United States senators from Georgia|U.S. Senator]] | before_election = [[Sam Nunn]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Sam Nunn]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Georgia (U.S. state)}} The '''1990 United States Senate election in Georgia''' was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] U.S. Senator [[Sam Nunn]] won re-election to a fourth term uncontested.{{cite web |url=http://clerk.house.gov/member_info/electionInfo/1990election.pdf |title=Statistics of the Congressional Election of November 6, 1990 | last=Dendy |first=Dallas L. |format=PDF}} This is the last time a Democrat was re-elected to the Senate from the state until [[2022 United States Senate election in Georgia|2022]].
